lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tb28Cd2Ni2 (reduced formula Tb14CdNi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over nine independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies 12-coordinate Tb and Ni environments as close-packed-like local arrangements, with Tb centers surrounded by 10 Tb and 2 Ni neighbors and Ni centers by 12 Tb neighbors. Tb–Tb neighbor distances range from about 3.54 to 3.62 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Tb-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing edges and faces, with some corner- and edge-sharing also observed between Tb polyhedra.
